positions.as_written: Read the medial restraints along their course, since their attachments sit near the physis in a growing knee.
Read the physis at the femoral attachment, because an attachment injury there is a physeal question.
Assess the patella's own ossification, which is irregular at some stages.
A bony procedure that an adult would be offered may be deferred until maturity, which makes skeletal stage a finding the report should carry.
